children: Alphabet broadly launched Gemini 4 Carbon, touting it as its strongest model for complex tasks. The model ranked first on a 200-task benchmark, with API pricing set to increase after November 30.
Alphabet (GOOGL) plans to invest $10 billion in nonvoting Anthropic shares, matching Nvidia in a $26 billion deal. The investment may cut Google’s separate financing commitment by up to $10 billion.
Alphabet (GOOGL) expanded its Adobe partnership, adding Acrobat to Drive and Gmail, bringing Adobe tools to Gemini and Google Search’s AI Mode, and integrating Google AI models into Adobe apps.
Alphabet (GOOGL) set Gemini 4 Carbon API rates at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens through Nov. 30, 2026. Rates double on Dec. 1.
Alphabet (GOOGL) and Adobe will explore AI-powered editing tools for Photoshop, including prompt-based image edits and options to choose from generated variations.
Alphabet’s Google Cloud named UiPath a launch partner for Gemini in healthcare, enabling users to trigger and monitor UiPath automations while retaining platform governance and human oversight.
Google DeepMind’s AI models accurately forecast Hurricane Isaias’ track, generating up to 1,000 storm scenarios. Forecasters combine the outputs with other models and real-time observations.
